name: HireArt
tagline: All-in-one platform to hire, manage, and pay contract W2 workers, freelancers, and staffing vendors.
description: HireArt provides a single self‑serve UI for employer of record services, on‑demand sourcing, vendor management, and freelancer management. It supports W2 contractors, 1099 freelancers, and staffing vendors while offering compliance guardrails and cost‑saving analytics. The platform also includes program management expertise and real‑time visibility into workforce metrics.

name: Amplitude
tagline: AI‑powered product analytics that turn customer signals into smarter decisions
description: Amplitude offers product analytics, AI‑driven feedback, session replay, and feature experimentation for product teams. It provides a free tier with up to 2 million events per month and scales to enterprise‑grade usage. The platform integrates AI agents to surface insights and recommend actions automatically.

name: Apollo
tagline: Build and manage AI‑ready domain models for your APIs with Apollo GraphOS.
description: Apollo GraphOS is a platform that lets enterprises build, operate, and secure a domain model over their existing APIs and services. It provides unified API federation, low‑latency access, precise security controls, and full observability for AI agents and applications.

name: HackerRank
tagline: Market-leading coding test and interview solution for hiring developers
description: HackerRank provides online coding tests and technical interview platforms for hiring developers. It helps companies assess engineering fundamentals and AI fluency. It is trusted by thousands of companies and millions of developers.

name: OneSignal
tagline: Omni-channel messaging platform for push, email, SMS, and in-app notifications powered by AI.
description: OneSignal is a customer engagement platform that provides mobile push, web push, SMS, email, and in‑app messaging. It is used by over 2 million businesses and handles billions of messages each year. The service offers AI‑driven lifecycle automation and integrates with Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native, Expo, and Unity SDKs.

name: Streak
tagline: Turn Gmail into a powerful CRM for high‑performing teams.
description: Streak is a CRM that lives inside Gmail, allowing users to manage pipelines, contacts, and deals directly from their inbox. It offers AI‑assisted data entry, automated email logging, and customizable pipelines for teams. The platform integrates with popular apps and provides mobile access via a dedicated app.

name: AgileMD
tagline: Predictive analytics and clinical pathways to reduce deterioration and improve outcomes.
description: AgileMD provides FDA‑cleared AI‑driven early warning (eCART) and clinical pathways that integrate directly into EHR workflows. It is deployed in over 500 hospitals, supporting 220,000 clinical users and more than 5 million patient encounters. The platform enables rapid implementation, real‑time risk stratification, and reporting across health systems.

name: Sift
tagline: AI‑powered fraud prevention platform that protects payments, accounts and sign‑ups in real time.
description: Sift uses AI agents and global data to detect and stop payment fraud, account takeover, and fake account creation for over 700 brands. It provides real‑time decisions and automated workflows across the entire customer journey.

name: LeadGenius
tagline: Real-time, compliant B2B contact data and buyer intelligence worldwide.
description: LeadGenius provides real-time, compliant B2B contact data powered by AI and human‑in‑the‑loop. It offers global coverage across EMEA, LATAM, and APAC, delivering warm leads and buying‑group visibility. The platform integrates with CRM and MAP systems for contact monitoring and activation.

name: Imgix
tagline: Optimize and transform every image and video from its URL
description: Imgix is a visual media platform that optimizes, transforms, and delivers images and videos directly from a URL using over 400 parameters. It serves content through a global CDN with automatic format selection such as AVIF or WebP. Users can start for free without a credit card and scale to billions of images per day.

name: Close
tagline: Close CRM: AI‑powered sales automation that calls, texts, emails and updates leads so you can focus on selling.
description: Close is a CRM with a built‑in AI teammate that can call leads, qualify prospects, book meetings and keep the CRM up to date automatically. It combines calling, email, SMS, automation and AI in one platform to help teams reach more leads, follow up faster and close more deals.

name: Stripe
tagline: Financial infrastructure to accept payments, manage billing, and move money globally.
description: Stripe is a financial services platform that enables businesses to accept online and in‑person payments, issue cards, and manage subscriptions. It supports over 135 currencies and payment methods and provides tools such as Radar for fraud prevention and Sigma for analytics. Stripe serves startups to Fortune 100 companies across 160 countries.

name: Directed Edge
tagline: Half a million product recommendations daily for Shopify stores
description: Directed Edge provides a Shopify app that delivers up to half a million product recommendations per day. It offers various recommendation types such as related products, cart recommendations, bundles, personalized and top products, plus advanced hand‑picking and business rule features. Users can import data via CSV and customize rules with Liquid.

name: Mixpanel
tagline: Product intelligence platform with AI‑powered analytics, session replay, experiments and feature flags.
description: Mixpanel is a product intelligence platform that provides analytics, session replay, experiments, feature flags, and AI‑powered insights. It helps teams understand user behavior, identify drop‑off points, and make data‑driven decisions. The platform includes AI agents that surface insights and a context engine for data governance.

name: Olark
tagline: AI-powered chat agent that answers questions, qualifies leads, and integrates with your CRM 24/7.
description: Olark’s AI agent is trained on your website in under a minute and answers visitor questions in real time. It qualifies leads, monitors visitor behavior, and can be connected to CRM, Shopify, and other tools. The service requires no code and is trusted by over 12,000 businesses.

name: RescueTime
tagline: Take Back Control of Your Time
description: RescueTime automatically tracks time spent on apps and websites and offers a Focus mode that blocks distractions. It also provides Timesheets for project, client, and task tracking with detailed reports and alerts. The service is used by millions and offers a 14‑day free trial.

name: Zentail
tagline: Multichannel ecommerce platform that automates listings, inventory, orders, pricing, and analytics.
description: Zentail is a multichannel platform that helps ecommerce brands manage and grow across online marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, Target, and eBay. It automates product listings, inventory, orders, pricing, and analytics, enabling faster launches and higher profitability. The software also monitors marketplace changes to keep listings compliant.

name: Zapier
tagline: Automate AI workflows across 10,000+ apps with Zapier.
description: Zapier lets you build automated workflows, called Zaps, that connect AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to thousands of apps. It supports over 10,000 integrations and offers enterprise‑grade security and governance. The platform provides self‑healing, deterministic AI workflows for reliable automation.

name: Benchling
tagline: Unlocking the power of biotech with modern software for modern science
description: Benchling is a cloud‑based platform for biotechnology research and development. It provides a biology‑first environment for scientific data management, collaboration, and AI‑driven insights. The platform supports end‑to‑end workflows across biology, chemistry, RNA, peptides, and more.

name: Flightfox
tagline: Complex travel. Made easy.
description: Flightfox provides expert‑managed group travel planning, booking, and monitoring for students, teams, offsites, and events. Their specialists handle itinerary creation, unaccompanied‑minor requirements, and travel‑day support. Over 1,000,000 travelers have used the service.

name: Padlet
tagline: Beautiful boards and canvases for visual thinkers and learners.
description: Padlet provides visual collaboration tools such as boards and digital sandboxes for creative work and education. It is used by 40 million people worldwide and offers free sign‑up with instant access. The platform supports organizing, sharing, and collaborating on ideas in a visual format.

name: RADAR
tagline: Know what's in your store all the time, in real-time.
description: RADAR provides a fully integrated RFID hardware and software solution that tracks every item in a store in real time with high speed and location accuracy. It enables autonomous checkout by automatically adding items to a customer's cart and charging them upon exit. It also offers item‑level analytics to improve inventory management and restocking.

name: Asseta
tagline: The honest and sensible way to buy semiconductor fab spare parts and equipment.
description: Asseta is a semiconductor fab spare parts marketplace founded in 2013. It hosts over 450,000 part and equipment listings and has completed more than 30,000 part sales since 2014. Buyers can request quotes from multiple suppliers and purchase directly through the platform.

name: Estimote, Inc.
tagline: Indoor location and sensing platform that powers navigation, occupancy detection, and smart space interactions.
description: Estimote provides indoor location hardware, software and developer kits that enable real‑time location services and space intelligence. Its SpaceTimeOS operating system runs on physical spaces, while UWB and BLE beacons deliver precise positioning and occupancy sensing. The platform also offers wearables and radar sensors for presence detection without requiring smartphones.

name: Panorama Education
tagline: Improving outcomes for 15M students, powered by AI
description: Panorama Education provides a secure AI‑driven platform that integrates district data—including assessments, attendance, behavior, and surveys—to support K‑12 student outcomes. It enables MTSS, special education, learning feedback, and college‑and‑career readiness across more than 2,000 districts and 15 million students.

name: Webflow
tagline: Design, build, and launch AI‑optimized websites without code.
description: Webflow is a no‑code platform that lets teams design, develop, and publish websites using a visual canvas and built‑in CMS. It includes AI‑driven SEO and A/B testing tools, collaboration features, and enterprise‑grade hosting and security.

tagline: Managed retail data and analytics platform that unifies all sources into a trusted AI‑ready warehouse.
description: 42 Technologies provides a managed retail data and analytics platform for brands, unifying data from ecommerce, retail, wholesale, marketplaces, ERP and marketing into a single data warehouse. The platform includes a retail semantic layer and proprietary BI dashboard that enable AI‑ready insights, stockout analysis, and margin optimization. It delivers structured data to AI tools such as Claude, CoPilot, and ChatGPT.

name: Ambition
tagline: Drive revenue predictability through structured coaching, AI‑powered revenue insights, and operationalized productivity.
description: Ambition is a performance orchestration platform for revenue teams that provides AI‑driven coaching, automation workflows, and real‑time performance intelligence. It helps managers run scalable 1‑on‑1 coaching, activate seller behaviors, and forecast revenue with contextual insights.

name: Flexport
tagline: AI-powered platform simplifying global trade and logistics.
description: Flexport builds an AI-powered, autonomous platform that runs the entire supply chain, making global trade easier. The company operates in 135 countries with a network of 45+ offices and serves 13,000 brands. Flexport offers career growth programs such as Flexport Academy and global talent summits.

name: PiinPoint
tagline: AI-powered location intelligence to help businesses find optimal expansion sites.
description: PiinPoint is a fast, intuitive, and affordable platform that uses AI-driven predictive analytics and real-world data to help businesses identify the best locations for growth. It supports the entire location‑decision lifecycle with collaborative tools and generates professional reports for real‑estate insights.
